title: Telemundo: El Pelotazo
tagline: Giving a brand-new Telemundo sports show an identity fans could recognize in a second.

body: El Pelotazo was a brand-new sports talk show, which meant building its identity from a blank slate. The opportunity was huge — and so was the risk of a look that blended into a crowded sports lineup.
With only a few weeks from ideation to delivery, keeping the client and the artist team aligned on one clear brand direction was critical.

As Creative Director, I worked directly with Telemundo to understand the show's goals, then led the creative vision from concept to final delivery — directing concept and motion artists to capture the show's energy and tone in a full brand identity and studio package.

The direction that resonated was bright, bold color, oversized 3D environments and Rube Goldberg-inspired machines — a playful, high-energy look that gave the show its own personality. Kinetic camera moves and balls flying through frame gave it a signature momentum, so it felt like El Pelotazo before a host said a word.
led: Led the brand vision from concept to delivery
Ran weekly client reviews to keep the brand on course

impact.note: The reaction from the client and stakeholders was overwhelmingly positive, exceeding expectations across the board — elevating the brand and helping secure future business.
